rationale: C03 supplies a concrete amendment template closely matching the child: it amends an earlier directive governing an organization's membership and designation authority, then preserves the tenure of existing members through a non-termination clause. The child's second section substantially elaborates that same distinctive transitional device by preserving existing members, chairman, and alternates while allowing later termination by the newly empowered Secretary of Defense. C20 has similar membership-designation and continuity machinery, while C11 shares the narrower amendment-and-redesignation structure, but neither matches the child as closely as C03.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The third paragraph of [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... is hereby amended to read as follows
shared_material.parent_excerpt: [DIRECTIVE_REFERENCE] ... is hereby amended to read as follows
shared_material.explanation: Both use the same operative formula to replace provisions of an earlier directive.

shared_material.child_excerpt: each of whom shall be designated by the Secretary of Defense
shared_material.parent_excerpt: The head of each such specified department or agency shall designate the officers and employees from his department or agency ... who shall be members of the Council
shared_material.explanation: Both revise organizational membership by assigning designation authority to department or agency leadership.

shared_material.child_excerpt: The amendment made by section 1 hereof shall not be construed as terminating the tenure of any person who is a member, chairman, or alternate member ... on the date of this order
shared_material.parent_excerpt: This order shall not be construed as terminating the tenure of any person who has heretofore been designated as a member of the Council.
shared_material.explanation: This is a distinctive, nearly verbatim transitional protection for incumbent members and is strong evidence of reusable drafting.
